result.question: How did Uzziah trespass against Yahweh, his God, when he became powerful?

readings.answer: By entering the temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.
readings.support: for he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense

assessments.reason: Matches 26:16 exactly: “he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense,” which is the same as entering Yahweh’s temple to burn incense.

result.reason: Verse 26:16 directly states he entered the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.
